idea-plugin.name: MyBatis Log Helper
idea-plugin.description:
别再手动拼 SQL 了，我帮你搞定

Don't manually spell SQL anymore, I'll take care of it for you

将 MyBatis 日志还原为可执行 SQL。支持语法高亮、自动格式化及一键复制。

Restore MyBatis logs to executable SQL instantly. Features syntax highlighting, formatting, and one-click copy.

如何打开 Tool Window

  1. 在 IDEA 右侧工具窗口栏找到 MyBatis Log Helper 图标并点击打开。
  2. 若未显示：View → Tool Windows → MyBatis Log Helper。

How to Open the Tool Window

  1. Locate and click the MyBatis Log Helper icon on the right sidebar of IDEA
  2. If not visible, go to the main menu:View → Tool Windows → MyBatis Log Helper.

Tool Window 使用方法

  1. 选择 Console 会话后点击 Start 开始监听日志。
  2. 左侧列表展示解析出的 SQL，右侧预览区支持格式化与复制。
  3. 支持搜索筛选、历史回看、复制。

Tool Window Usage

  1. Select your Console session and click Start to begin monitoring logs.
  2. The Left Panel displays the list of parsed SQL statements.
  3. The Right Preview Pane supports SQL formatting and copying.
  4. Features include search filtering, history review, and one-click copy.

Console 右键使用方法

  1. 在 Run/Debug Console 中选中任意包含 MyBatis 日志的行。
  2. 右键选择 Preview Executable SQL (预览可执行 SQL) 或 Copy Executable SQL (直接复制)。
  3. 弹出轻量气泡可预览/复制。

Console Context Menu Usage

  1. Highlight any lines containing MyBatis logs in the standard Run/Debug Console.
  2. Right-click and select Preview Executable SQL or Copy Executable SQL.
  3. A lightweight popup will appear for instant preview or copying.

action.description: Preview executable SQL from MyBatis logs
